items.title: A connected unramified cover of a geometrically unibranch integral scheme with a dominant component is etale and irreducible
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma, attributed in the author's reference to SGA 1, proves that an unramified morphism with connected source, at least one component dominating the target, over an integral geometrically unibranch base, is etale and has irreducible source. The proof uses the unibranch hypothesis to control the local structure of the target, shows that every component of the source must dominate, and then concludes etaleness from unramifiedness plus flatness over the whole source. Using geometric unibranchness to force flatness is the load-bearing step. Retained author proof at lines 10510-10527.
